deploy-bot: [staging] Deploy started · service=inference-orchestrator · env=staging · tag=release-2026-03-hotfix-2 · commit=abc1234def · initiator=@maria · change_window=2026-03-19T22:00Z-23:00Z · run_id=deploy-1769981234

maria: Kicking off canary 1/5. Will watch latency, 5xx, and reranker error rate. Smoke tests queued.

ajay: Noted. I won't change autoscaler for canary, let's keep baseline. If p95 climbs we can revert.

lynne: Tailing dashboards now: inference-p50/p95, tokens/s, reranker-5xx. Alerts copied into the thread.

smoke-bot: smoke-tests: 12/12 checks passed (42s). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1769981234/smoke

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift -> 10% completed. No elevated 5xx in first 5m.

maria: Seeing p50 +20ms on orchestrator, p95 flat. Acceptable for now, holding for 15m to validate.

ajay: Agree. Watch reranker-specific requests — those hit the model-serving path.

sam-oncall: Alert: spike of 500s targeting /v1/rerank at 1769981356, rate ~0.3% of requests, ~15 failures/min.

lynne: Quick grep of logs shows repeated "kv_cache mismatch" in reranker worker after model load:

```
ERROR inference.reranker: cache_mismatch: expected kv-shape=(12,8192), got (8,8192)
trace: model_load -> quantize_path -> serve_request
```

maria: Hmm — this looks like a quantization variant mismatch for the new reranker build. We have two options: full rollback or isolate reranker to previous tag and roll forward the rest. Recommend pinning reranker to release-2026-03-hotfix-1 and proceeding.

ajay: +1 to pin. We should also flip the feature flag that routes rare prompts to the new reranker model until we fix the quant path.

maria: I'll apply the pin and the FF. Command I will run:

```
# pin reranker to previous working image
deployctl pin-version --service inference-reranker --env staging --tag release-2026-03-hotfix-1 --reason "kv_cache/quant mismatch on hotfix-2"
# disable experimental reranker fallback
deployctl feature-flag set --name reranker_new_variant --env staging --state off
```

smoke-bot: pin-version job queued: job/1769981380. Smoke suite re-run scheduled.

deploy-bot: Pin applied, feature-flag toggled. Canary resumed -> 30% traffic. Reranker service image now set to release-2026-03-hotfix-1 (rolled back only for that component).

smoke-bot: smoke-tests (after pin) : 12/12 passed (47s). No 5xx observed in reranker path.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed (partial rollforward). Summary: run_id=deploy-1769981234 · status=completed-with-pinned-component · duration=13m · pinned_components=[inference-reranker:release-2026-03-hotfix-1] · rollback=false · incidents=1(minor, kv_cache mismatch) · notes="reranker quant path regression; pinned to previous tag in staging, engineering to investigate before prod roll"

maria: Thanks team — closing the change window. I'll add a short release note and link the follow-up ticket.

ajay: Filing follow-up: ENG-PLAT-4321 to investigate quantization path and add unit test for kv shapes.

lynne: I'll keep an eye on post-deploy metrics for the next hour and ping if anything drifts.

maria: Good run. We'll aim to reproduce locally and patch before the prod cutover. :thumbsup:
